title: Great overall but lacks zoom in features
body:
Apple Notes is an amazing note-taking app overall. The handwriting feels smooth and natural, shape recognition is excellent, and organizing notes with folders and tags is incredibly simple. The clean interface and seamless integration across Apple devices make it a joy to use.

The only thing stopping it from being perfect is the limited zoom. Even basic pinch-to-zoom beyond the current limit (for example, up to 200%) isn’t available. For people who take handwritten notes, being able to zoom in further makes writing more comfortable and precise. The current limitation can make long note-taking sessions feel cramped and less enjoyable.

If Apple simply allowed a higher pinch-to-zoom level for handwritten notes, Apple Notes would be nearly perfect for everyday note-taking.

title: Overheating and Battery Drain with Apple Notes on iPad Air M3
body:
I’ve been a long-time user of the Notes app and typically love its simplicity and tight integration with iPhone and mac. However, I’ve recently encountered a major issue on my iPad Air M3 that’s made it hard to rely on for handwritten note-taking.

Whenever I use the Notes app with my Apple Pencil Pro to take handwritten notes, my iPad starts overheating significantly. (I tried turning off auto refine, hover, math detection yet face just the same) It becomes hot to the touch, to the point where I need to stop using it just to let it cool down. On top of that, the battery drains unusually fast—dropping from 77% to 33% in just one and half hour. Under normal use, I easily get two days on a full charge, so this is highly abnormal. And it’s a newly bought iPad barely a week old 

What’s most frustrating is that this doesn’t happen when using the Apple Pencil on other apps like Good notes—even for extended sessions. This points to an issue specifically with the Notes app and how it interacts with the Apple Pencil on certain iPads. 

And I’m now kinda happy I tried good notes and will be purchasing its premium plans. Wouldn’t have done that, if not for the heating issues with notes app. But still it needs fix 

Please fix this overheating and battery issue. Until then, I’ve had to move my note-taking to other third-party apps.

title: Apple Notes Needs More Features for Better Note-Taking
body:
As someone who frequently uses an iPad for note-taking, I’ve noticed that Apple Notes lacks several key features that are essential for an optimal experience. While it’s a simple and easy-to-use app, it doesn’t offer the advanced functionality found in apps like Samsung Notes or third-party alternatives.

For example, Samsung Notes provides a wider variety of tools, such as better handwriting recognition, advanced drawing tools, and seamless integration of multimedia elements like images and audio recordings. These features make note-taking more interactive and productive. In contrast, Apple Notes feels quite basic for users who rely heavily on their iPads for professional or academic purposes.

Given that many people purchase iPads specifically for note-taking, Apple should enhance the Notes app with features like improved organization, better stylus support, and more customization options. Until then, users like me are forced to depend on third-party apps to meet our needs.

Apple, it’s time to level up Notes for those of us who want to use it to its full potential.

title: Feedback on Apple’s Notes App: My Experience and Suggestions.
body:
I’ve been using Apple’s Notes app for 1-2 years, and overall, I find it to be a great tool for productivity. However, I have a few suggestions that could make the app even better:

	1.	Clipboard for Photos and Texts: It would be incredibly useful to have a clipboard feature for storing photos, texts, and other items temporarily. This would make organizing and accessing content much easier.
	2.	Table Bugs: There are some frustrating bugs when working with tables. For example, when I click on a column, it often shifts unexpectedly. This disrupts the workflow and could use some improvement.
	3.	Manual Keyboard Button: It would be great if there was a manual button to raise the keyboard whenever needed. This feature would give users more control over their typing experience.

Despite these issues, I really appreciate the app’s interface and overall usability. It has significantly contributed to my productivity. Thanks for all the hard work that goes into making this app!

title: The Notes app has become unusable
body:
I have used my M1 iPad Pro as my daily driver for productivity and it was all sunshine and roses until I updated to iPadOS 16. Ever since I did that, the Notes app has had over a dozen glitches, bugs, etc., combined together, totally ruins the experience of using an iPad for note taking. Sometimes, the notes app crashes while I am doing serious work, and when I reopen it, I find all data has been erased. 

Moreover, the Apple Pencil experience “used” to be great, but after the update it became a total nightmare. The pencil marks take more than a few seconds to appear and the delay has become unacceptable. It is impossible to write with it. Even the screen has started flickering only “while using the Notes app”.

Last comes the battery life issue. My relatively new iPad Pro has only 18 completed charge cycles (I checked by running various diagnostics). After the freaking update, once I used the notes app for only 35 minutes and it drained from 100–29%. Are you serious? 71% drain within 35 minutes— just INSANE!!! Never expected such bad experience from a reputed company like Apple. Utterly disappointed and antagonised.
